Name: Em and Harry's Exotic Cattle
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
[center]Love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34291]Em's Cows[/url]﻿ but can't decide which ones you want? Feel like the more exotic cattle breeds should feel different than a regular dairy cow? Introducing [b]Em and Harry's Exotic Cattle[/b]![/center]
﻿[b]New Cattle Breeds[/b]
This mod adds "Exotic Cattle" as a new option at Marnie's shop, a single shop entry that includes the Highland Cow (red and blonde skins), Water Buffalo, American Bison, Musk Ox, and Yak (white, black, brown, and spotted skins). They differ a little bit from the vanilla Dairy Cows; they immediately produce Large Milk, or Large Goat Milk in the case of the Musk Ox (a vanilla item) and occasionally Cream (a new item); but they eat more grass per day when outside than a regular cow and lose happiness much faster if not petted every day. Initially, they only can be milked every other day, but maintain their happiness and after about 3 hearts they'll begin to produce every day.

Cream counts as a milk item and can be used in recipes that call for Any Milk. Add it to the Cheese Press to produce Iridium star Cheese; depending on the quality of the Cream, it may produce double the cheese. You can also drink Cream for a small Farming buff.

﻿[b]A New Special Order[/b]
Being a bit harder to take care of then Dairy Cows, you'll need to prove yourself a bit before Marnie will sell them to you; by default, the Exotic Cattle aren't available at the beginning of the game, but instead unlocked by a Special Order. Marnie's got a craving for fried cheese curds and asks someone to drop some cheese off at the Saloon; complete this quest and she'll start selling Exotic Cattle in the store.

﻿[b]Satisfying Petting Compatibility[/b]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19798]Satisfying Animal Petting[/url] installed, this mod will automatically add Cream as a rare drop when petting vanilla cows and goats. You can also turn this feature on via config option, even without Satisfying Animal Petting installed.

﻿[b]Config Options[/b]
"[i]Exotic Cattle Icon[/i]": The icon representing Exotic Cattle in Marnie's shop can be changed; options are Bison, Buffalo, Highland Cow Red, Highland Cow Blonde, Musk Ox, and Yak, default Highland Cow Red.
"[i]Cream Icon[/i]": There are two versions of the sprite for Cream, Harrison's and Em's. Default Em's.
"[i]Petting Perks[/i]": While added by default if you have Satisfying Animal Petting installed, the petting perks can also be enabled via config option even without the other mod installed.
"[i]Special Order[/i]": Enabled by default, you can configure whether the Exotic Cattle must first be unlocked by completing a Special Order. If disabled, the Special Order will still show up on the board.
"[i]Unique Milk Names[/i]": Enabled by default, you can configure whether the milk objects should display the type of animal they come from (ie, Yak Milk, Buffalo Milk, etc). Highland Cows, being cows, simply display regular milk. The Milk objects are all still the same object (selling one will count towards selling a Large Milk), but their display names will prevent them from stacking with regular Large Milk.
"[i]Cow Cream Enable[/i]" and "[i]Goat Cream Enable[/i]": When the petting perks are enabled, you can separately enable or disable vanilla cows and goats dropping Cream when petted.
"[i]Friendship Requirement[/i]": The level of friendship required by cows and goats before they can produce Cream; default 1000. Can be configured separately for cows and goats.
"[i]Chance[/i]": The chance cows and goats will produce Cream when you pet them; default 0.02. Can be configured separately for cows and goats.

﻿[b]Compatibilities[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43265]Cheesemakers Guild[/url]: Fully integrated; Cream can be used in cheesemaking, and the Rancher benefits added by the Cheesemakers Guild allows regular cows and goats to produce Cream as well.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia[/url]: Cream can be processed by the Butter Churn to make Butter; similar to the cheese, it make Iridium star Butter with a chance to double the output that grows with the quality of the Cream.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url]: Cream has tags that allow it to work with Flexible Cooking. It's categorized as a milk item, so even in the base game it can be used in place of milk for recipes that call for milk.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]: While all cattle breeds are available without this mod, my goodness does the Bazaar make this easier. Highland Cows, Water Buffalo, Bison, Musk Ox, and Yak show up as different kinda within the "Exotic Cattle" entry in Livestock Bazaar, while the Red and Blonde Highland Cows are alternate skins.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff[/url]: Optional for most of this mod, but required for the petting perks.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20525]Otter's Additional Barn Animals[/url]: Compatible as of version 1.0.3. When I made this mod it was originally for private use but I ended up making it public; in doing so, I forgot to add a mod-specific prefix to the animal names, so an issue can potentially arise if you have another mod that adds an animal of the same name. A known example of this was Otter's Yak and my Yak both simply being "Yak" in game, so if both mods are active, only one Yak will show up in Marnie's shop. Adding the prefix to all my animals would make any animals in existing saves turn into error animals, so to fix this in the most unobtrusive manner I can, my mod will detect if Otter's mod is active and change the Yak in that instance; the result will be that if you have one of my Yaks and then add Otter's mod, my Yak will become one of Otter's Yaks. This issue could still arise with other mods that also load animals of the same name, so if you see this issue show up, let me know and I can add compatibility.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3634]Trent's New Animals[/url]: Compatible as of version 1.0.6. Similar situation as with Otter's Yak above.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27321]Goat Mod[/url]: If you've configured to allow goats to give you cream as a possible petting perk, the female goats added by this mod (including wool goats) are included in that.

﻿[b]Credits[/b]
All sprites for the cows are done by Em, coding by me. We each made a sprite for the Cream. I originally started working on this for my personal Animal mod just by adding extra skins to the cows so I could have more of Em's cows on my farm, then got carried away making some changes to make them feel unique. I told Em about it and she suggested I make it public, so here we are!

[b]﻿Translate Me![/b]
This mod is translation ready, feel free to post your own translation if you'd like as long as you don't use ai to do so.

[center]If you like these, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36362]me and Em's Capybara[/url], a custom Barn animal that pets your other animals, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37426]Murmur of Bees[/url], my bee house overhaul mod![/center]
